description: Only open-web discovery was available; no LexisNexis or systematically equivalent archive of Kazakhstan national/regional outlets was queried. Results frequently returned 2022 retrospectives despite 2023 date terms. The web engine’s date terms are not proof of strict filtering.
required_followup: A later review may use additional permitted local and regional archives if available; keep all current candidates and do not infer that no other protests occurred.

description: E001 remains pending_evidence: Azattyq caption reports approximately 100 at Republic Square and says most were political activists, while reports distinguish the activist action from a nearby memorial gathering. The saved evidence does not securely attribute 50+ simultaneous attendees to the distinct activist subgroup.
required_followup: Keep pending_evidence unless permitted event-specific evidence resolves the caption count’s subgroup and simultaneous-attendance scope; do not transfer the broader memorial crowd.

description: E002 Jan 7 memorial actions are described as planned; Azattyq says some activists reached Almaty central square but gives no crowd count or state-policy demand, and reports detentions in three cities.
required_followup: Seek distinct contemporaneous local reporting only if useful and permitted; otherwise retain pending_evidence. Do not infer a >=50 gathering or state target from the plan.

description: KKS-Sicim Jan 16–20 action was a substantial worksite strike, but reports locate it at work sites/industrial base and direct pay/job-grade demands at the private joint-venture contractor. Public forum and own-state policy target were not established.
required_followup: Reconsider only if a source documents a public gathering and demand directed at Kazakhstan state policy; do not use employee headcount as protest attendance.

description: The direct Masa Media body request timed out at the web-tool layer with “(400) Timeout fetching”; no publisher HTTP response was exposed and no retry was made. Known HRW and AP restrictions also prevented body access to relevant retrospective results; those snippets are not used as current event evidence.
required_followup: No retry of the timed-out URL or held stories; use the opened Sputnik, Orda and Azattyq material and retain source-specific limitations.

description: Jan 5 activist protest is reported to have ended after about an hour with dispersal; no continuation is evidenced. Jan 7 is a separate planned memorial action with incomplete occurrence evidence. Jan 16 KKS-Sicim strike ended Jan 20 per Azattyq. No carry-over into February is established from current saved evidence.
required_followup: Review adjacent-month reports only for a documented continuation or newly reported evidence about these specific January episodes; do not duplicate them into February.
